axes.model_access: A tool suite: official API docs list Uncrop, Remove Background, Image Upscaling (up to x16), Cleanup, Remove Text, Text to Image and Replace Background (beta). Text-to-image and background replacement build on Stable Diffusion, while the other tools use dedicated models. Users choose a tool, not raw weights (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web app at clipdrop.co plus the API (`https://clipdrop-api.co/...`); processing runs in the vendor cloud. The API takes a multipart/form-data single image and returns the processed image binary directly (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Uploads are multipart and results come back as PNG/JPG binary for the caller to save. Official API docs are organised as single request-response calls without project or history endpoints; web-side works and history follow the account UI (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Single-image atomic operations with synchronous responses: one request handles one image, and batching or concurrency is orchestrated by the caller (official docs give per-image endpoints plus file-size/resolution limits). No hosted queue or resume-after-shutdown task surface (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Remove Background, Cleanup, Replace Background, Uncrop, Image Upscaler (up to x16), Relight (a web-side signature tool), Text Remover, Universal Resizer and Text to Image; the API covers seven of these endpoint lines (2026-11-21).
axes.context: No projects or memory: a single-image-in, single-image-out tool flow. Context is maintained entirely by the caller (human or API integrator), and outputs carry no cross-request state (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Free tiers apply per-tool daily caps, with paid plans raising limits; API access uses an API key. Ownership follows Jasper/Clipdrop terms: customer content is not claimed by the vendor, and uploads must be owned or licensed (including likeness and trademarks); training terms follow the agreement and Jasper privacy policy (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: e-commerce product-image batches, atomic cutout/object-removal/relight/upscale operations and API integration into one’s own product. Not fit: generative creation (text-to-image is a side tool), style consistency or project management (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official API docs, tool pages and Jasper legal pages. Relight quality boundaries, free-tier overage behaviour and post-migration API compatibility need account-level measurement.

related: Former owner: Clipdrop was once under Stability, now the API runs on Jasper terms — see the Stability dossier for its open-model main line.
Both editing-oriented: Firefly embeds in the professional design suite, Clipdrop is a standalone atomic toolset.
Editing surfaces overlap (inpainting/background replacement): Recraft has editing inside a creation bench, Clipdrop is a pure toolset.
API downstream: Clipdrop's per-tool APIs often reach batch flows through Zapier-style automation platforms — the automation side is where it scales.
